occurrence_sentence: Microsoft Quantum, she said, has built a quantum platform for research discovery, combining the strengths of high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI) and quantum computing to spur groundbreaking advances. Discussing the recent developments in Microsoft's quantum division, Svore said, "What we've developed recently is Azure Quantum Elements. This is a platform for really accelerating computational chemistry and materials science discovery and innovation."
